name: skeleton-loaders
tagline_zh: 数据加载时页面乱跳？用这个技能生成与真实内容像素级对齐的骨架屏，连 shimmer 动画都调好，告别布局抖动。
tagline_en: Stop layout shift with pixel-perfect skeletons that mirror real content, shimmer included. Build loading states.
desc_en: For building skeleton loading states that are pixel-perfect matches of real content. Use this skill whenever adding loading states to components, building skeletons for async data, handling pending loader states in route transitions, or implementing the shimmer animation pattern. Also trigger when the user asks about preventing layout shift during data fetching.
why_zh: 同类工具只给占位块，它却读取真实组件结构，自动生成匹配尺寸的骨架，连圆角和间距都分毫不差。
why_en: Unlike generic placeholders, it introspects your actual components to output skeletons with exact dimensions, radii, and spacing.
